checkpoint.title: Grinding, part 2 (repeats): one round of MIMIEN's grind at Victory Road 2F, from the Indigo Plateau nurse and back to heal

events.why: one grind round: from the nurse to Victory Road 2F (45, 10), switch-grind MIMIEN up to heal_every (7) battles or until Lv 33 (Recycle into Move 1, every other move declined), back to the nurse and heal. PokemonSimulation PR #119: 77 battles, 11 heal trips, about 53 min in all

metadata.notes: A repeating checkpoint: each passing round is saved at the nurse, so a failure reloads the last round's save and only that round runs again. The rounds end once MIMIEN is at least Lv 33 and knows Recycle (read after each round); a run resumed from any round's save starts at the nurse. A round's checks hold on any save: the party, nothing spent, back at the nurse. The level never drops in the game and HP has no reader, so neither is checked.
